prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single seamless square 2D hand-painted neutral terrain detail texture for a colorful cartoon puzzle saga map. Top-down flat texture, NOT a scene, not an atlas. Very pale warm ivory base with a handful of large softly curved pale-gray/cream color patches, sparse tiny simplified brush flecks and a few abstract small rounded grass strokes. Extremely low contrast (white to pale warm gray only), meant to be tinted green in a game shader. Broad simple painted shapes, cheerful clean casual-game illustration. The texture is uniformly lit; no perspective, no directional shadow, no road, no buildings, no objects, no borders, no text, no black areas, no high-frequency noise. Seamless edges matching in all directions. Opaque background. It should give flat-colored ground a soft painted character without looking busy.
